title: Weber® SLATE GPSB 76 cm Premium Griddle
spec_text:
The Weber® SLATE GPSB 76 cm Premium Griddle is the ultimate freestanding flat-top grill for outdoor cooking enthusiasts who want both power and precision. Featuring a 76 cm pre-seasoned carbon steel cooking surface, this griddle is ready to handle everything from breakfast favourites to sizzling stir-fries.

 Its three high-performance stainless steel burners deliver even, consistent heat across the full surface. With a closed cabinet design, the GPSB model also includes built-in storage space for your tools and accessories, helping keep your outdoor kitchen neat and organised.

 Equipped with an electronic ignition, adjustable control knobs, a full-size front-access grease tray, and a convenient side table for food prep, this premium griddle is engineered for both performance and convenience.

 Please note: Weber products require additional handling time when collecting from our stores.

 Description 

   

 The Z515E 54 in. complete bagging system includes everything needed to successfully bag grass clippings.
